1.en: By the sky containing great stars

3.en: And [by] the witness and what is witnessed,

4.en: Cursed were the companions of the trench

6.en: When they were sitting near it

7.ar: وَهُمْ عَلَىٰ مَا يَفْعَلُونَ بِٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ شُهُودٌ
7.en: And they, to what they were doing against the believers, were witnesses.

8.ar: وَمَا نَقَمُوا۟ مِنْهُمْ إِلَّآ أَن يُؤْمِنُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْحَمِيدِ
8.en: And they resented them not except because they believed in Allah, the Exalted in Might, the Praiseworthy,

9.ar: ٱلَّذِى لَهُۥ مُلْكُ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ شَهِيدٌ
9.en: To whom belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth. And Allah, over all things, is Witness.

10.ar: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ فَتَنُوا۟ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَٱلْمُؤْمِنَـٰتِ ثُمَّ لَمْ يَتُوبُوا۟ فَلَهُمْ عَذَابُ جَهَنَّمَ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابُ ٱلْحَرِيقِ
10.en: Indeed, those who have tortured the believing men and believing women and then have not repented will have the punishment of Hell, and they will have the punishment of the Burning Fire.

11.ar: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ لَهُمْ جَنَّـٰتٌ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَـٰرُ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْفَوْزُ ٱلْكَبِيرُ
11.en: Indeed, those who have believed and done righteous deeds will have gardens beneath which rivers flow. That is the great attainment.

12.en: Indeed, the vengeance of your Lord is severe.

13.en: Indeed, it is He who originates [creation] and repeats.

14.en: And He is the Forgiving, the Affectionate,

17.en: Has there reached you the story of the soldiers -

19.en: But they who disbelieve are in [persistent] denial,

20.en: While Allah encompasses them from behind.

21.en: But this is an honored Qur'an
